hook: "Should not have to carry one less crew member," the North Pacific Council's Advisory Panel said of boats sent from cameras to observers.
deck_summary: From the camera on its mast to the same camera on a hatch, the deck shows 76 of 172 boats that would move, a 3-trip tally, cheaper trips, 96 of 97 sharks, a $6,003 gear case, the Gulf's 14.25 percent and an empty berth.
